Description

Looking for a Full Stack Developer that is proficient in both backend and frontend development and is able to handle the end to end SDLC and invovled processes

The role

You will work in a cross functional DevOps team developing functionality services related to charging Together with the teams Solution Architect you will contribute to the technical design and software delivery practices ensuring aspects like security robustness scalability efficient CICD identifying maintenance and enabler needs

Your profile

As a person we believe you take responsibility and enjoy teamwork solving our challenges together and contribute with team spirit

A university degree in Computer science or similar

6-9 years experience in web based frontend and backend development of end user applications and services

Experience from agile development DevSecOps practices and Continuous Deployment

Knowledge in following techniques is a great plus Java 18 and aboveSprintboot Hubernate JavaScript React REST GraphQL Git Test automation frameworks

Industry experience around logistics electric vehicle charging or electrical energy is not required but an advantage

Fluent in English both written and spoken
